title: Payment Giant Stripe Acquires OpenRouter for $7 Billion: AI Model Router Teams Up with Payment Giant
excerpt: Bloomberg reported that payment giant Stripe has finalized the acquisition of AI infrastructure startup OpenRouter for more than $7 billion, approximately 47.3
content_html:
Bloomberg reported that payment giant Stripe has finalized the acquisition of AI infrastructure startup OpenRouter for more than $7 billion, approximately 47.3 billion yuan. This platform, which helps users select AI models on demand, is about to become a new member of the leading player's ecosystem in the payments industry.

From "Stripe of the AI world" to being acquired by Stripe

OpenRouter's core capability is matching different models based on specific needs and budgets, selecting the most suitable one for various tasks. CEO Alex Atallah once compared the company to "Stripe of the AI world," as it provides a unified access point, allowing users to freely call different models while avoiding being locked into a single vendor.

In May this year, OpenRouter completed a $113 million Series B funding round, with an estimated valuation of $1.3 billion. The investor lineup includes Sequoia Capital, a16z, Menlo Ventures, and CapitalG, part of Alphabet. The company claims its global user base has reached 8 million, with access to over 400 AI models, showing strong growth momentum.

5x Premium, a Major Acquisition in AI Infrastructure

Last month, the Wall Street Journal reported that talks between the two parties had begun, and now Bloomberg has further confirmed that the deal has been finalized. If completed, Stripe's offer will be more than five times the valuation of OpenRouter's previous funding round, representing a significant premium.

This acquisition will also rank among the largest transactions in the AI infrastructure sector in recent years. For Stripe, acquiring this model aggregation entry point means that the payment giant is extending its reach to the "traffic hub" of large model calls, securing a key position in the commercialization of AI.

content_html_zh:
彭博社报道称，支付巨头 Stripe 已敲定以超过 70 亿美元（约合人民币 473 亿元）收购人工智能基础设施初创公司 OpenRouter。 这个帮助用户按需选择AI模型的平台即将成为支付行业领先者生态系统的新成员。

从“AI界的Stripe”到被Stripe收购

OpenRouter的核心能力是根据特定的需求和预算匹配不同的模型，为各种任务选择最合适的模型。 CEO Alex Atallah 曾将该公司比作“AI 世界的 Stripe”，因为它提供了统一的接入点，允许用户自由调用不同的模型，同时避免被锁定在单一供应商。

今年5月，OpenRouter完成了1.13亿美元的B轮融资，预计估值为13亿美元。 投资者阵容包括红杉资本、a16z、Menlo Ventures 和 Alphabet 旗下的 CapitalG。 该公司声称其全球用户群已达800万，拥有超过400个AI模型，显示出强劲的增长势头。

5x Premium，人工智能基础设施领域的重大收购

上个月，《华尔街日报》报道称，双方的谈判已经开始，现在彭博社进一步确认交易已经敲定。 如果完成，Stripe 的报价将是 OpenRouter 上一轮融资估值的五倍以上，这是一个巨大的溢价。

此次收购也将跻身近年来人工智能基础设施领域最大的交易之列。 对于Stripe来说，获得这个模型聚合入口点，意味着这家支付巨头正在将触角延伸至大模型调用的“流量枢纽”，在AI商业化进程中占据关键地位。
